Orange Township names parking sites for Founders Festival
Orange Township says festival-goers can park at North Road Park and Olentangy High School.
Orange Township has designated North Road Park and Olentangy High School as parking locations for the Founders Festival, according to the township. The announcement was posted on the township's website on Tuesday, Sept. 22, 2026.
The township did not provide a date, time or additional details about the festival itself in the posting, nor did it specify addresses for the two parking sites.
The parking announcement appeared alongside several other township notices. Orange Township offices will be closed on Monday, Oct. 12, 2026, in observance of Columbus Day, the township said. Separately, the township is seeking requests for proposals to update its Comprehensive Plan, according to the posting, though further contact information was not included in the available text.
The township also referenced a planned closure of the East Orange Road railroad crossing, citing the Delaware County Engineer's Office, though the posting did not specify the closure's start date or duration.
In addition, the township noted that trick-or-treat will again fall on Oct. 31, after the Orange Township Board of Trustees voted last year to establish that date as the permanent annual date, according to the township.
A trail closure was also mentioned for the path adjacent to Summersweet Circle, Sunflower Street and Scarlet Avenue, though the posting did not state when the closure would begin or end.
Residents seeking more information about the Founders Festival or any of the other notices were not given additional contact details in the material provided by the township.
Source: Orange Township, OH, https://www.orangetwp.org/news/where-can-i-park-for-the-founders-festival/
